title: ON-THE-FLY PREFERENCE ALIGNMENT VIA PRINCIPLE-GUIDED DECODING
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical decoding-time method for preference alignment in LLMs. While it utilizes datasets like HH-RLHF (Helpful and Harmless) and includes case studies on social stereotypes (e.g., Irish people and alcohol), it is primarily a methodology paper for alignment rather than a specific benchmark or evaluation of religious or ethical systems.
